Unit 1 · Letters Aa Bb Cc
1 Learn (Track 01)
Listen and repeat. Then trace the letters.
Aa, Bb, Cc
Trace the letters: A a, B b, C c

A Color the picture that begins with the letter.
Aa, Bb, Cc. Example: the apple is colored.
B Circle the right letter.
Say the word. Circle its first letter.
1 ant: a b c
2 cup: a b c
3 bat: a b c

C Listen and repeat. (Track 02)
Aa: apple, alligator, ant
Bb: book, bed, bat
Cc: cat, cap, cup

D Match the pictures with the letters.
book, apple, cat · Aa, Bb, Cc
E Write the letter a, b or c.
Look at the shape. Write its first letter.

F Listen to the word. (Track 03)
Color its beginning letter: a b c
G Listen to the beginning sound. (Track 04)
Circle the right picture.
1 alligator, book, cap
2 bat, apple, cup
3 ant, cat, bed

H Trace and write the letters.
Aa, Bb, Cc
ABC, abc
I finished Unit 1! Teacher stamp or sticker

Unit 2 · Letters Dd Ee Ff
1 Learn (Track 05)
Listen and repeat. Then trace the letters.
Dd, Ee, Ff
Trace the letters: D d, E e, F f

A Color the picture that begins with the letter.
Dd, Ee, Ff. Example: the dog is colored.
B Circle the right letter.
Say the word. Circle its first letter.
1 flag: d e f
2 elf: d e f
3 duck: d e f

Audio and Credits
Listen: this book has 46 audio tracks (MP3). The track number in each headphone tag, for example Track 07, matches the file name Book1_Track07.mp3. Find the files in the Audio folder of your download. Play them on any phone, tablet or computer, as often as you like. Press play, listen, pause, then answer. Most tracks are played twice. No audio yet? Teachers can read the scripts aloud from the Teacher's Guide.

Jurassic English Phonics
Book 1 · The Alphabet
Jurassic English Phonics is a five-book series that helps young learners read and spell English with confidence.
In Book 1, children learn the 26 letters: their names, their sounds and how to write them, through themed units, chants, games and puzzles.
8 themed units, 2 review units and a Challenge · Letter tracing with stroke order on every unit · A test and key vocabulary list at the back
The series: Book 1, Book 2, Book 3, Book 4, Book 5
by Matthew Goslee · WorldWise Learning · www.jurassicenglish.com
